description:
AgentSpaces for Apache Groovy 6: GDK-style extension methods on the Space
    API and the capability clients, a fleet configuration DSL that mirrors the
    starter's properties, an agent DSL bound by the Java binder through a
    generated interface, a script base class so one .groovy file is a peer,
    await-ready twins of every blocking verb, a type-checking extension, a
    shell over a running peer, and a channel bridge over the incubating
    groovy.concurrent toolkit. A standalone project on the published
    AgentSpaces libraries.
